reaction_equations: (CH3)2Pt-(MeCp)∗+ O2 → Pt-O∗+ CO2 + H2O + other product
surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: The Pt ALD mechanism using (methylcyclopentadienyl) trimethyl platinum and O2 as precursor is: 1st half cycle: Pt-O∗+ (MeCp)Pt(CH3)3 → (CH3)2Pt-(MeCp)∗+ CO2 + H2O + other product 2nd half cycle: (CH3)2Pt-(MeCp)∗+ O2 → Pt-O∗+ CO2 + H2O + other product where ‘*’ represents an active surface species, and Pt-O* represents oxygen that is adsorbed on the platinum surface.
